problem: `judge` accepts the same tile index twice and never checks the length of `chosen`: in «За буквами» with decoys, taps [0,1,0,1] pass «мама» and earn XP.
fix: Return `undefined` when `chosen` repeats an index or (for `tiles`) its length differs from `expected.length`.

problem: With eveningNotification on, slots are capped by count over all times before filtering to earliest+latest time; with 5+ reminder times the plan covers fewer than 14 days and OS slots stay free (3-4 times are fine).
fix: Filter slots to the earliest/latest times before the count cap.

problem: Every `freezeUsed` event carries the same `freezesHeld` (the count after all the day's freezes); two freezes from 2 report 0 and 0, against analytics.ts:42.
`analytics.track` is awaited inside `inTurn` on the final solve, so later `play`/`keep` wait on a network round trip; game.ts uses `void`.
`refreshLinks` re-reads and rebuilds every Word card of the session on each eligibility change (early exit removed on purpose in #1749).
fix: Rebuild only cards whose linked ids changed eligibility.

problem: `apply()` awaits `mineOf(key)` (two userState reads) per pulled record, sequentially, inside merge's turn lock.
fix: Read the page's keys in parallel (reading only page keys is deliberate, so do not list all user state).

problem: Every append calls `change()`, rerunning `derive()` over the whole log.
fix: Update derived state incrementally from the appended record.

problem: `dayOf(date)` filters and sorts all records; the planner calls it per evening slot.
fix: Index records by date once in `derive()`; make `dayOf` a lookup.

problem: `tick` stores any number in `seconds` though the schema is `int().nonnegative()`; a bad tick makes the record fail to parse. Latent: the only caller floors and skips ≤ 0.
`tilesOf` never checks the alphabet has enough decoys; a short alphabet or long Word breaks the 4-column row or leaves no decoys.
fix: Leave out such Words or cap tiles at a multiple of 4.

problem: Both `open*Crossword` repeat the ports parameter block and the inline no-XP default.
Cast-based `Object.fromEntries(...) as Record<...>` record builder, copied in mix.ts.
fix: One typed `recordOf(keys, fn)` helper in Core.

problem: `freeze()` and `earn()` share the same 15-line append body.
Same signsIn/cancels/fails/holds/signIn body in both fakes.
`for (;;)` retry after an unreadable Entry ends only because card-order ids come from filtered lists; nothing enforces it.
fix: Bound the loop by the number of eligible ids.
